name: Baked sweet potato
intro: Bake it until the skin puffs and the sugars run, split it, and fill it. The potato is the whole dinner.
time: About an hour, almost all of it in the oven
yield: Dinner tonight — bake extra for the hash

proteins.name: Black beans
proteins.timing: Warmed in a small pan, 5 minutes.

proteins.name: No protein
proteins.timing: Dates and feta carry it. Use the sweet and salty flavor.

needs: 2 sweet potatoes for dinner — bake 4, the extra two are the hash
Salted Greek yogurt, a big spoonful per potato

steps.text: Heat the oven. Scrub the potatoes, prick each a few times with a fork, rub with oil and salt, and set them on a sheet pan.
Bake until the skin puffs away from the flesh and syrup beads out and caramelizes on the pan. Soft isn't done — keep going.
Warm the beans or the leftover protein.
Split each potato lengthwise, push the ends toward the middle so it opens, and salt the inside.
Yogurt, then the beans or protein, then your flavor.

leftovers: Baked sweet potatoes keep four days. Cube them cold for the skillet hash.
